description: One compact 16-bit RPG inventory icon of two overlapping chipped fish scale fragments. Broad asymmetric fan-shaped nacre plates, scalloped ridges and broken jagged corners. Three distinct metallic shades, cool teal shadow, pale silver blue, small ivory glint. Dark navy pixel contour, legible at 16 pixels. Transparent background, no glow, no spirit, no fish, no coins, no letters.
